name: Fiddlehead
description: An endless dive into a self-similar fern: every frond is lined with smaller copies of itself, and each one unfurls as the camera reaches it. The fern glows in a stained-glass colour bath that flows down its branches; bass swells the light riding the colour bands, treble glitters on the leaflet edges, the passage's loudness sets the exposure, and every beat on the cached beat grid sends a nerve impulse from the trunk out to the leaflet tips, downbeats stronger. Rendered by a compute descent; this fragment is only the dark ground shown while its fields bake.
author: Uzume engine

audio_routes.note: FH.16 r2 — every bass hit swells the whole fern's light: bassDev self-normalised against its own running mean (FernMusic.squash), instant attack, 0.18 s decay (FiddleheadFern+Dive). Read on the CPU; the shader receives it as P.au.x.

FH.16 r2 — trebDev self-normalised (it runs ~100x below bassDev), gating a smooth per-leaflet twinkle on the leaflet edges (P.au.y). Never a per-frame random sparkle: that read as grain at fullscreen.

FH.16 r2 — each wrap of the cached grid's barPhase01 is a downbeat: ONE nerve impulse per bar, born on the stem filling the view and racing out to the leaflet tips in about a second (Matt's pick over per-beat impulses, which measured 3 % and 0.2 s late). Palette looks also step every 32 of these bars. Not declared: spectralSurge -> exposure (the passage's loudness), because the replay harness does not carry it (ReplayHarnessRouteCoverageTests.carriedPrimitives); it is exercised by FiddleheadFernTests instead.
